//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the NOTIFICATIONS widget — the `.pa-notifications` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Layout.notifications/1`, svelte `feedback/NotificationsPanel.svelte`). A `pa-*` component (NOT migrated to pure-css); ~21 `.pa-notifications*` selectors in dist/css/main.css. SCOPE = CAPABILITY-ONLY, ZERO strict-compare scenarios — same path as navbar.json / sidebar.json / settings-panel.json, because the two wrappers model DIFFERENT LEVELS of the block tree and so cannot share a golden ROOT at all: keen `notifications/1` is the WHOLE bell+panel widget — root `<div id="notifications" class="pa-notifications">` containing the `.pa-notifications__btn` bell (icon + badge) AND the `.pa-notifications__panel` dropdown (header/list/footer), with a DEFAULT hook-anchor id="notifications" on the root + a `id="notifications-panel"` + inline `style="display: none;"` on the panel (toggle_notifications(id) targets them); svelte `NotificationsPanel` renders ONLY the panel — root `<div class="pa-notifications__panel">` (header/list/footer), with NO `.pa-notifications` wrapper, NO bell button, NO id (visibility via an `is-open` class from the `show` prop + a sibling NotificationBell component). So even the ROOT element class differs (pa-notifications vs pa-notifications__panel), and keen's default id="notifications" (kept by the normalizer, like sidebar.json's id="sidebar") can never equal svelte's id-free panel. A shared full-tree golden can't even write the root opening tag. The whole `pa-notifications__*` family (btn/badge/icon/panel/header/list/list--page/item/item--unread/icon-wrapper/icon-wrapper--{variant}/content/time/footer/actions/mark-read) is split across the two components' differing trees → deferred as prose. Correctness is carried by the completeness contract: the base `pa-notifications` class + every `__*` element class accounted for + the `class` passthrough both wrappers accept on their (divergent) root. Canonical shape: packages/core/snippets/notifications.html (the bell+panel widget).

propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to each wrapper's (divergent) root — keen on the `.pa-notifications` widget root, svelte on the `.pa-notifications__panel` panel root (svelte `class`, keen `class`). Class passthrough, declared for axis-2; not a core modifier.

goldenConventions: No scenarios → no goldens. See the leading note: keen models the whole bell+panel widget (root `.pa-notifications`, default hook id) while svelte models only the panel (root `.pa-notifications__panel`, no id), so the two SSR trees share no reconcilable root. Correctness is carried by the structural contract: the base block class, the class-passthrough feature, and the deferred `__*` element inventory. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace would be normalized away if a golden existed.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-notifications(--|__)'). The `.pa-notifications` BLOCK has ZERO modifiers (no `.pa-notifications--*`). Every styled class is a `__*` ELEMENT class, split across the two wrappers' differing trees (keen widget vs svelte panel) → all deferred. The ONE declarable shared feature is the class passthrough (on each wrapper's own root). `produces: null` — no block modifier exists.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to each wrapper's root (keen `.pa-notifications`, svelte `.pa-notifications__panel`); svelte `class`, keen `class`. Declared in both maps for axis-2; not exercised by a strict scenario (capability-only fixture).

deferred.//: Every element class of the pa-notifications block. They are split across the two wrappers' DIFFERENT trees — keen's widget emits the bell (__btn/__badge/__icon) + panel chrome; svelte's panel emits the panel chrome; the ITEMS (__item*/__icon-wrapper*/__content/__time/__actions) come from keen's notification_item/1 sub-component vs svelte's in-component iteration. None can be strict-compared because the roots don't reconcile (see the leading note). Acknowledged as PROSE. All class names exist in main.css and are emitted identically-named by whichever wrapper owns that part of the tree.
deferred.pa-notifications__btn: the bell button (keen widget only; svelte's bell is a separate NotificationBell component). Opens/toggles the panel.
deferred.pa-notifications__badge: unread-count badge on the bell (keen widget only).
deferred.pa-notifications__icon: bell glyph inside the button (keen widget), and the per-item leading icon slot.
deferred.pa-notifications__panel: the dropdown panel — keen emits it as a CHILD of the widget (with an id + inline display:none); svelte emits it as its ROOT (is-open class toggles visibility). Same class, divergent position/attrs.
deferred.pa-notifications__header: panel header (title + mark-all-read). Emitted by both inside their panel.
deferred.pa-notifications__mark-read: the "mark all as read" button in the header (svelte default header; keen leaves the header content to the consumer).
deferred.pa-notifications__list: the <ul> of items inside the panel.
deferred.pa-notifications__list--page: page-view list modifier (svelte isPageView — a bare full-page list; keen has no page-view mode on this fn).
deferred.pa-notifications__item: a single notification <li> (keen notification_item/1 sub-component; svelte in-component iteration).
deferred.pa-notifications__icon-wrapper--primary: primary icon-tile tint (one of the five role tints; keen variant / svelte iconVariant).
deferred.pa-notifications__footer: the panel footer (e.g. a "View all" link).
deferred.pa-notifications__actions: per-item hover-revealed actions row (svelte itemActions slot / keen rest-provided).
